models.skills: Each skill represents a marketable ability the user has claimed. Skills can be validated through AI assessments, document uploads, or video demonstrations to increase trust and earning potential.
models.skillCategories: Categories help organize skills into browsable groups, making it easier for users to find and add skills they have.
models.skillSuggestions: AI-recommended and trending skills that the user might want to add based on their profile, location, and market demand.
models.relatedCourses: Courses that help users learn or improve a skill, linked from skill cards to encourage upskilling.

relationships: Each Skill belongs to a SkillCategory
Skills can have multiple RelatedCourses for learning and improvement
Skills reference RelatedListings (products/services the user sells using this skill)
SkillSuggestions are potential Skills the user can add
